title: All {count} Achievements in Anime Vanguards
meta_description: Compare Anime Vanguards achievements by objective group, requirement, availability, and reward across Story, Raid, Collector, and Unit goals.
intro_md: Achievements turn normal progression into named objective groups with rewards along the way and a larger bonus at the end. A good route follows the maps, modes, or units you already need, letting the tracker quietly pay rent while you play.
description_md:
## How achievement groups work

Each achievement belongs to a named group, such as a Story map, Raid area, Collector track, or featured Unit goal. Individual entries have their own requirements and rewards. A Completion Bonus or Bonus Rewards entry asks you to finish the rest of that group before it pays its separate reward bundle.

Treat the group bonus as the finish line, not the first task. Progress the individual objectives together where possible, then look for the missing requirement inside the same group instead of replaying unrelated content and hoping the tracker develops sympathy.

## Planning Story and Raid objectives

Story achievements commonly follow acts on Nightmare difficulty. Clearing the acts in order keeps the map group moving toward its completion reward, while the requirement text tells you when a specific difficulty matters.

Raid and Dungeon groups mix act clears, repeated clears, boss kills, and special conditions. Read the exact condition before starting a run because bringing the wrong unit, missing a named boss, or choosing the wrong act can leave an otherwise successful clear outside the achievement.

## Progressing Collector and Unit goals

Collector objectives reward account growth through owning and summoning units. These can advance while you build a roster, so they are best treated as long progression goals rather than a reason to spend every summon currency at once.

Unit objectives follow one named character through tasks such as evolution, ascension, stage clears, boss activity, and takedowns. Put that unit into content that also advances another goal, then keep it in the team until the remaining requirement is complete. One run doing two jobs is the rare kind of paperwork worth celebrating.

## Finishing group rewards

Group completion entries can grant a separate mix of currency, reroll items, mounts, emotes, or other rewards. The exact reward belongs to that group, so finishing one Story map or Unit track does not complete a different group with a similar objective.

Before calling a group finished, compare its unfinished requirements by group name. Availability also matters for objectives tied to retired content, since an old requirement does not create a new route into a mode that is no longer open.
how_it_works_md: Status shows whether an objective is available. Category and Group place it in the right progression track, while Requirement and Reward explain what must be done and what that specific achievement grants.

description_json.Story: Story achievements follow named map groups, often through Nightmare acts. Finishing the individual map objectives opens that group's separate completion bonus.
description_json.Raid and Dungeon: These objectives cover Raid acts, Dungeon clears, bosses, repeated wins, and special run conditions. Each named activity keeps its own Bonus Rewards requirement.
description_json.Collector: Collector goals track roster ownership and summoning progress. Completing the whole Collector group unlocks its separate completion reward.
description_json.Unit: Unit groups follow a named character through evolution, ascension, clears, boss tasks, and takedowns. The group completion entry rewards finishing that character's full objective track.

faq_json.q: What is an achievement group in Anime Vanguards?
faq_json.a: A group connects related objectives under one Story map, Raid or Dungeon activity, Collector track, or Unit goal. Its completion entry requires the other achievements in that named group.

faq_json.q: How do Completion Bonus achievements work?
faq_json.a: Finish every required achievement in the named group. The Completion Bonus or Bonus Rewards entry then grants its own reward bundle, separate from the individual objective rewards.

faq_json.q: Do Story achievements require Nightmare difficulty?
faq_json.a: Many Story objectives name Nightmare difficulty directly. Follow the exact requirement because a clear on another difficulty may not advance that achievement.

faq_json.q: What tasks appear in Raid and Dungeon achievements?
faq_json.a: They can ask for act clears, repeated clears, boss kills, or special conditions involving a mode, stage, or unit. The requirement names the condition that must be met.
They can track evolution, ascension, stage clears, Boss Event clears, boss kills, and takedowns with a named unit. Completing the related Unit group unlocks its group reward.

faq_json.q: Can an unavailable achievement still be completed?
faq_json.a: Not if its required activity or route has ended. Availability shows whether the objective can currently be pursued through its listed requirement.

wiki_md: Achievements reward Story clears, Raid and Dungeon challenges, Collector progress, and long-term objectives for named units. Each objective sits inside a group with its own requirement and reward. Finishing every required objective in that group unlocks a separate Completion Bonus or Bonus Rewards entry, which can add currency, rerolls, mounts, emotes, or other rewards.
